name: Acadia National Park
summary: Where the mountains meet the Atlantic — granite peaks, Rockefeller's carriage roads, and the first sunrise in the country come fall.

lodging.name: Bar Harbor inn or Blackwoods Campground
lodging.blurb: Bar Harbor for walkable dinners; Blackwoods for a jump on the Cadillac sunrise.

foodMustTry.name: Popovers at Jordan Pond House
foodMustTry.blurb: Warm popovers with jam on the lawn above the pond — an Acadia ritual.

days.label: Day 34 — Cadillac Sunrise & Park Loop
days.summary: Beat the sun to the summit, then drive the park's greatest hits.

item.title: Sunrise on Cadillac Mountain

location.name: Cadillac Mountain Summit
location.address: Cadillac Summit Rd, Bar Harbor, ME

item.blurb: From October to March, the first place in the U.S. to catch the sunrise. A timed vehicle reservation is required in season.

item.title: Park Loop Road & Thunder Hole

location.name: Park Loop Road
location.address: Park Loop Rd, Bar Harbor, ME

item.blurb: The 27-mile loop past Sand Beach, the crash of Thunder Hole, and the cliffs at Otter Point.

days.label: Day 35 — Carriage Roads & Jordan Pond
days.summary: Car-free roads, stone bridges, and popovers.

item.title: Bike the carriage roads to Jordan Pond

location.name: Jordan Pond House
location.address: 2928 Park Loop Rd, Seal Harbor, ME

item.blurb: 45 miles of crushed-stone, car-free roads and hand-built bridges, ending with popovers at Jordan Pond.

days.label: Day 36 — Schoodic & the sea
days.summary: The quieter mainland side of the park and the whale-rich waters.

item.title: Bar Harbor whale watch
item.blurb: Finbacks and humpbacks offshore if the season and seas cooperate.

item.title: Bar Harbor village & the Shore Path
item.blurb: Maine trinkets, taffy, and a stroll along the oceanfront path.

days.label: Day 37 — Free Day
days.summary: Rest, kayak, or read on the pink granite. Optional ideas below.

freeMenu.title: Schoodic Peninsula loop
freeMenu.blurb: The uncrowded mainland corner of Acadia, with pounding surf on pink granite.

freeMenu.title: Swim (or shiver) at Sand Beach
freeMenu.blurb: A rare sand cove between the cliffs — the water is bracing.

days.label: Day 38 — Inland to the White Mountains
days.summary: A long leg west from the coast into New Hampshire's high country.

commute.scenicNote: The longest New England leg — the payoff is trading coast for alpine notches and peak foliage.
